specs.title: cp-002: CtrlCmdC copies the current Fabric selection into window__finnishClipboard
cp-004: CtrlCmdX cuts via copy plus delete
cp-005: CtrlCmdA selects all non-grid objects
cp-006: Delete and Backspace delete the current Fabric selection except while Direct Sel
cp-007: Escape clears the current selection
cp-014: A switches to Direct Select
cp-021: Numeric shortcuts 1 through 8 map to Select Hand Rectangle Ellipse Line Arrow Pe
cp-030: CtrlCmdG groups the current selection
cp-031: CtrlCmdShiftG ungroups the selected group
cp-032: CtrlCmd7 makes a clipping mask
cp-033: CtrlCmdAlt7 releases a clipping mask
cp-034: CtrlCmd8 makes a compound path
